{{Top|leg}}
'''Mos Espa Valid''' was a [[Bank/Legends|bank]] based in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Nairalav Shipping Co.]], a front company for [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]]'s [[Valarian Syndicate|criminal syndicate]], had an account in the bank. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Ovpi Urgon]] was one of the bank managers of Mos Espa Valid.<ref name="SWG:Ttgp">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Time to get paid|Yavin system}}</ref>
